title: RunnerTranscriptSnapshot
description: The normalized transcript view `agent-runner`'s `GET /runs/{id}` serves alongside a `runner.run-record.json`, ALWAYS populated (not gated behind a query parameter) — the server-side reduction of a run's raw stream-json/JSONL transcript into the few fields a remote caller actually needs, so no consumer has to parse the CLI's own wire format itself. Fulfils demand `factory-20260911-interface-extraction` criterion 2. Deliberately scoped to the tail/result summary a caller like Factory reconciles against — NOT the full structured per-event timeline (`session`/`events`/`transcriptSummary`) that `GET /runs/{id}` also serves for dashboard/design-studio's own richer UIs; that deeper taxonomy is those consumers' own proven need and is not extracted here, so this contract stays additive and proportional to what this demand's origin actually consumes.

transcriptTail.description: The last N raw lines of the run's transcript file (N defaults to the server's own window; `?tail=` overrides it). Always present, even for a still-`launched` run (may then be a shorter or empty tail).

result.description: The CLI's own final terminal answer, parsed from its terminal `result` line. `null` when the run has not yet produced one (still `launched`, or ended without a parseable result line) — never a placeholder string standing in for absence.

resultTruncated.description: True when `result` was clipped to a server-side budget rather than being the CLI's full, untruncated answer.
